items.title: Five tool-calling patterns that separate hobby AI agents from production ones
items.summary: 文章指出生产级AI智能体需采用五种工具调用模式以解决超时、循环及错误处理等常态问题。重点介绍了“显式工具调用预算”和“工具调用去重”等策略，通过限制单次交互的最大调用次数（如默认5次）及利用Map结构记录已执行的工具，有效防止API成本激增和数据重复调用。这些机制确保了智能体在复杂场景下的稳定性与成本控制能力。
items.why_now: Claude 4.5 发布，独立开发者需掌握生产级 Agent 模式以避坑。
items.summary_en: The article outlines five tool-calling patterns to transition AI agents from hobby projects to production environments, starting with explicit tool call budgets to prevent infinite loops and excessive API costs. It introduces code examples using Anthropic’s SDK and the Claude Sonnet 4.5 model to enforce limits, such as capping calls at five per turn. Additionally, it highlights the need for tool call deduplication to avoid redundant operations and potential data integrity issues.

items.title: [AINews] not much happened today
items.summary: Meta发布Brain2Qwerty v2，通过结合原始神经信号建模与语言模型，将非侵入式脑机接口的单词解码准确率提升至最高78%，并开源了训练代码及数据集。DeepSeek推出DSpark推理系统，在Qwen3-4B上实现了比Eagle3高30.9%的接受长度，确立了单GPU推测解码的新标准。此外，Arena平台在上线八个月后达到1亿美元年化收入，Cursor则发布了支持云端代理控制的iOS版本。
items.why_now: Cursor今日发布iOS版及远程智能体，为独立开发者提供新工具。
items.summary_en: Meta released Brain2Qwerty v2, achieving up to 78% word accuracy in real-time non-invasive brain-to-text decoding, while Cursor launched iOS support with always-on cloud agents. Arena achieved a $100M ARR run rate eight months post-launch, and Cline introduced a $9.99/mo subscription for discounted access to open-weight models like GLM 5.2 and DeepSeek. Additionally, DeepSeek’s DSpark emerged as a new state-of-the-art for single-GPU speculative decoding, offering significant efficiency gains over previous methods.

items.title: [AINews] Sonnet 5 today, and Fable 5 tomorrow
items.summary: Anthropic发布Claude Sonnet 5，作为新的默认中端前沿模型，提供100万token上下文窗口，并在编程和工具使用方面展现出顶级的代理能力。尽管官方定价维持在输入每百万token 3美元、输出15美元，但在8月31日/9月1日前推出输入2美元、输出10美元的促销费率。与此同时，备受期待的Fable 5模型并未随Sonnet 5一同发布，导致市场关注点集中在Sonnet 5的成本效益及其在Linux桌面端和Managed Agents平台上的扩展支持上。
items.why_now: Anthropic今日发布Sonnet 5 API并提供促销价，窗口期至8月底。
items.summary_en: Anthropic has launched Claude Sonnet 5, its new default mid-tier model featuring a 1M-token context window and enhanced agentic capabilities for coding and tool use. While maintaining a standard price of $3/M input and $15/M output tokens, the company introduced a promotional rate of $2/$10 until early September. The release coincides with platform expansions, including Linux support and updates to Managed Agents, though it lacked the anticipated simultaneous launch of the Fable 5 model.

items.title: Have your agent record video demos of its work with shot-scraper video
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10 版本新增了 `shot-scraper video` 命令，利用 Playwright 和 storyboard.yml 文件自动录制 Web 应用的操作演示视频。该功能可通过 GPT-5.5 xhigh 在 Codex Desktop 中根据特定 Prompt 自动生成复杂的 YAML 故事板，从而让编码代理高效产出工作演示。
items.why_now: shot-scraper今日发布1.10版，新增支持AI代理录制视频演示功能。
items.summary_en: The release of shot-scraper 1.10 introduces a video command that utilizes Playwright and a storyboard.yml file to automate the recording of web application routines. This tool enables coding agents, such as those powered by GPT-5.5, to generate visual demonstrations of their work, including complex workflows like bulk CSV insertion and table creation in Datasette.

items.title: The AI Cost-Modeling Handbook: I let Claude do the modeling, but never the arithmetic
items.summary: 作者构建了结合实时数据抓取与精确有理数计算内核（agent-calc）的AI成本建模管道，确保价格来源可审计且避免浮点误差。在评估Hermes Agent框架的最优模型时，DeepSeek V3.2 @ OpenRouter以$0.1145/百万token的混合成本和77的质量得分成为最具性价比选择，而DeepSeek V4 Flash在Fireworks上显示出更低的潜力成本。该方案通过分离LLM推理与数学计算，解决了传统方法中因幻觉或估算错误导致的成本误导问题。
items.why_now: 2026年模型价格月变，需实时数据建模以避坑。
items.summary_en: The author developed an auditable AI cost-modeling pipeline that separates live price aggregation via research agents from exact-rational arithmetic to prevent floating-point errors. DeepSeek V3.2 on OpenRouter emerged as the most cost-effective model for agentic workflows, achieving the lowest blended cost per quality score ($1.49x10^-3) among tested options. The system ensures reproducibility by sourcing real-time data and using a specialized kernel for precise financial calculations.

items.title: Experience "Starting an App" with AI -0 experience, 2,900 users and community funded
items.summary: 该开发者利用Claude AI（$20套餐）独立完成了一款农场统计应用的开发，在零代码经验下通过Facebook有机推广获得2,900名用户。应用采用完全免费且无广告的模式，依靠约60名用户的自愿捐赠（月收入约$135）及一次性礼物（累计$305）维持运营并覆盖每月约$71的成本。截至目前，该项目在上线不到一个月内已实现约$220的净利润，展示了AI辅助开发结合社区众筹模式的可行性。
items.why_now: 非程序员用Claude月入盈利，验证AI极速开发变现窗口。
items.summary_en: A non-coder built a homestead analytics app entirely using the Claude AI $20 plan, achieving 2,900 users and approximately $220 in profit within one month through voluntary donations. The project utilizes a lean tech stack including Vercel Pro, Supabase Pro, and Cloudflare for a total monthly cost of $71, while relying on organic Facebook marketing to acquire users without paid advertising.

items.title: diegosouzapw/OmniRoute
items.summary: OmniRoute 是一个免费 AI 网关，支持连接 Claude Code、Cursor 等 16+ 编程工具，提供 236 个提供商接口及 50+ 免费服务。通过 RTK+Caveman 堆叠压缩技术，该方案可节省 15–95% 的 Token 消耗（平均约 89%），并具备毫秒级自动故障转移能力。用户每月可获得约 16 亿免费 Token，首月叠加注册积分可达 21 亿，无需信用卡即可启动。
items.why_now: OmniRoute发布，聚合50+免费AI源并压缩Token，助开发者零成本开发。
items.summary_en: OmniRoute is a free AI gateway that aggregates over 236 providers, including 50+ with free tiers, to offer approximately 1.6 billion documented free tokens per month through a single endpoint. It enables seamless integration for coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot while utilizing RTK and Caveman stacked compression to reduce token usage by 15–95%.

items.title: xbtlin/ai-berkshire
items.summary: AI Berkshire 是一套兼容 Claude Code 与 Codex 的价值投资研究框架，集成巴菲特、芒格、段永平、李录四位大师方法论及多 Agent 并行对抗分析机制。该方案通过强制结构化输出、内置反偏见校验及精确金融计算工具，实现了从单一分析到可复用决策支持的升级。实盘数据显示，其 2024 年全年收益达 +69.29%，2025 年至今收益 +66.38%，显著跑赢标普500 及恒生指数等主要市场基准。
items.why_now: 无明确时效信号
items.summary_en: AI Berkshire is an investment research framework compatible with Claude Code and Codex that integrates the methodologies of Buffett, Munger, Duan Yongping, and Li Lu through multi-agent adversarial analysis. The system utilizes four parallel agents to enforce structured decision-making, bias mitigation, and precise financial calculations, ensuring reproducible and high-quality investment reports. This approach has demonstrated significant outperformance against major indices, achieving returns of +69.29% in 2024 and +66.38% year-to-date in 2025.

items.title: ogulcancelik/herdr
items.summary: herdr 是一个基于 Rust 开发的轻量级终端 Agent 多路复用器，旨在让开发者在单个终端内同时运行和管理多个编码 Agent。它通过独立的真实终端视图、清晰的 Agent 状态指示（阻塞/工作中/完成）以及支持 SSH 远程连接和断线重连的功能，解决了传统 tmux 缺乏 Agent 感知能力的问题。
items.why_now: herdr发布，让独立开发者在终端高效管理多个AI Agent。
items.summary_en: Herdr is a lightweight, mouse-native terminal multiplexer built in Rust that allows users to run and manage multiple coding agents within a single interface. It provides real-time visibility into agent states (blocked, working, done) and supports persistent sessions via SSH, ensuring processes survive disconnections. The tool offers features like workspaces, tabs, and panes, serving as a specialized alternative to tmux for agent orchestration without requiring external GUI wrappers.

items.title: browser-use/video-use
items.summary: video-use 是一款开源视频编辑工具，支持通过 Claude Code 等编码代理自动剪辑视频，具备去除填充词、自动调色、字幕嵌入及并行生成动画叠加层等核心能力。其技术优势在于利用 ElevenLabs Scribe 提取音频转录和视觉复合信息替代原始帧分析，将处理数据量从数千万 token 降至 12KB 文本加少量图片，大幅优于传统暴力扫描方案。用户只需将素材放入文件夹并配置 API Key，即可通过自然语言指令完成从策略建议到最终渲染的全流程自动化编辑。
items.why_now: Browser Use 刚发布视频编辑工具 video-use
items.summary_en: Video-use is an open-source tool that enables coding agents like Claude Code to edit videos by processing transcripts and selective visual composites rather than raw frames. It automates tasks such as removing filler words, auto-color grading, adding subtitles, and generating parallel animation overlays while maintaining session memory via project.md.

items.title: mattpocockuk 的 /writing-great-skills：编写可预测 AI Skill 的指南
items.summary: @mattpocockuk 发布的 /writing-great-skills 旨在通过分层加载和明确完成标准，将 AI Skill 转化为稳定触发的“可预测工作流”，以解决模型执行波动及注意力分散问题。该指南核心在于区分 Model-invoked 与 User-invoked 的触发成本，利用 leading word 压缩行为指令，并通过 progressive disclosure 管理 SKILL.md 内外信息层级。实践建议包括实施 no-op 测试剔除无效描述，以及依据独立触发词或流程控制需求对 Skill 进行拆分，从而提升模型行为的确定性与效率。
items.why_now: mattpocock发布新Skill指南，教你构建可预测AI工作流。
items.summary_en: The `writing-great-skills` tool by mattpocockuk provides a framework for creating predictable AI Skills by prioritizing stable behavioral triggers over static knowledge bases. It advocates for a three-layer structure (steps, references, external files) and emphasizes precise completion criteria to prevent premature task termination and attention dilution. The methodology utilizes "leading words" to compress behavioral requirements and offers diagnostic strategies for common issues like duplication and sedimentation.

items.title: 早报｜苹果iPhone 18 Pro大规模泄露/SK海力士启动赴美IPO/Claude Sonnet 5正式上线
items.summary: Anthropic 上线 Claude Sonnet 5，通过强化 AI Agent 自主规划与工具调用能力，以每百万输入 Token 2 美元起的定价大幅降低智能体运行成本。月之暗面 Kimi 新一轮融资投前估值升至 315 亿美元，其 6 月中旬 ARR 突破 3 亿美元，API 收入占比超七成。
items.why_now: Claude Sonnet 5刚上线，旨在大幅降低AI智能体运行成本。
items.summary_en: Hundreds of gigabytes of confidential files, including over 200,000 documents detailing iPhone 18 Pro components and A20 chip designs, were leaked to the dark web after a ransomware attack on Apple’s Indian supplier, Tata Electronics. Meanwhile, Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5, a new medium-sized model designed to lower AI agent costs while matching the performance of larger models in programming and autonomous task execution.

items.title: 美团 LongCat 发布旗舰模型 LongCat-2.0
items.summary: 美团发布旗舰模型 LongCat-2.0，该模型采用 1.6T 参数 MoE 架构，原生支持 1M 上下文窗口，并在 SWE-bench Pro 基准测试中取得 59.5 分，性能与主流闭源模型持平。其核心能力在于专为智能体构建的 LSA 稀疏注意力机制及 MOPD 门控路由技术，实现了每 token 动态激活 33B–56B 参数且无算力浪费。目前模型已在 SiliconFlow 上线，定价为输入缓存 0.015 美元/M token，输入 0.75 美元/M token，输出 2.95 美元/M token。
items.why_now: LongCat-2.0旗舰模型今日于SiliconFlow上线Day 0
items.summary_en: Meituan's LongCat-2.0 is a 1.6T parameter MoE model featuring a native 1M context window and specialized routing for agent tasks, now available on SiliconFlow at $0.015/$0.75/$2.95 per 1M tokens. It achieves 59.5 on SWE-bench Pro, matching mainstream closed-source models, while dynamically activating 33B–56B parameters to eliminate computational waste.

items.why_now: Kimi估值升至315亿美元，ARR突破3亿美元。

Concurrently, UPPERCASE Robotics launched its new embodied intelligence series, including the FabriX industrial large model and the Xifeng humanoid robot, aiming to empower 10,000 industrial sites within three years.

items.title: What's new in Claude Sonnet 5
items.summary: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5，其性能接近 Opus 4.8，拥有 100 万 token 上下文窗口及 12.8 万最大输出限制，并默认开启自适应思考功能。该模型采用新分词器，导致英文输入 token 数增加约 40%，实际成本较 Sonnet 4.6 上涨约 30%。此外，模型移除了 temperature、top_p 等采样参数支持，且安全防护标准对标 Opus 4.7。
items.why_now: Anthropic今晨发布Sonnet 5，但新Tokenizer致英文成本实涨30%。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, a model with performance close to Opus 4.8, featuring a 1 million token context window, 128,000 maximum output tokens, and adaptive thinking enabled by default. While the base pricing remains identical to Sonnet 4.6, the introduction of a new tokenizer increases token counts by approximately 30%, effectively raising costs by 1.28x to 1.42x depending on the language or code type. Additionally, the update removes support for sampling parameters like temperature and top_p, aligning its toolset with previous versions while maintaining similar safety safeguards regarding cyber tasks.

items.title: shot-scraper 1.10
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10 版本引入了 video storyboard.yml 新功能，支持通过该配置记录代理工作的视频演示。
items.why_now: 无明确时效信号
items.summary_en: shot-scraper version 1.10 introduces a major new feature: video storyboard generation via `shot-scraper video storyboard.yml`. This update allows agents to automatically record and structure video demonstrations of their work processes.

items.title: Sonnet 5 review: I ran 64 generations to find out if it's worth it
items.summary: 作者利用自建的 How I AI Bench 基准测试框架，对 Anthropic 的 Sonnet 5 与 Sonnet 4.6、Opus 4.8、GPT-5.5 及 Gemini 3 Pro 进行了盲测，涵盖 PRD 质量、原型生成及智能体任务完成等维度。该评估体系结合了 70% 的人类主观评分与 30% 的 LLM 裁判评分，并通过 Claude Code 在 45 分钟内搭建完成，旨在提供可重复且客观的性能对比数据。
items.why_now: Anthropic刚发布Sonnet 5，独立开发者可借此评估前沿模型性能。
items.summary_en: The author conducted a blind comparative evaluation of Anthropic’s Sonnet 5 against Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.8, GPT-5.5, and Gemini 3 Pro using a custom "How I AI Bench" harness built in under 45 minutes with Claude Code. The assessment combined 70% human intuition scoring with 30% LLM-as-judge metrics across PRD quality, prototype generation, and agentic tasks to determine optimal model usage for different workflows.

items.title: Show HN: Turning Sentry errors into AI generated GitHub PRs with fixes
items.summary: 该工具利用BugZero.dev将Sentry错误自动转化为带有修复代码的GitHub Pull Requests。通过集成AI技术，实现了从错误监控到代码修复的自动化闭环。
items.why_now: BugZero发布，将错误自动转为PR修复代码。
items.summary_en: BugZero is a tool that automatically converts Sentry error reports into AI-generated GitHub pull requests containing code fixes. It streamlines debugging by leveraging artificial intelligence to analyze stack traces and propose immediate solutions. The service is accessible via bugzero.dev.

items.title: Show HN: Morph Reflexes – Multi-head classifiers for agent traces
items.summary: Morph Reflexes 是一款基于 vLLM 分支构建的多头分类器，利用混合注意力机制和 KV/cache 复用技术，实现了亚 30 毫秒的推理延迟。该系统通过共享主干网络同时处理多个语义信号，相比使用前沿大模型作为裁判，在大规模 Agent 追踪中具有显著的成本和速度优势。
items.why_now: 发布Morph Reflexes API，亚毫秒级低成本监控Agent行为。
items.summary_en: Morph Reflexes is a multi-head classifier for agent traces that uses a custom vLLM-forked inference engine to deliver sub-30ms latency with less than 2ms overhead per additional reflex. By sharing a single backbone and KV/cache across multiple heads, it enables cost-effective, scalable monitoring of behavioral signals like looping or frustration without relying on expensive frontier models. The system is offered as an API-first tool for developers, allowing for the deployment of custom reflexes via their dashboard or SDK.

items.title: Show HN: Openleetcode – LeetCode runner where tests live in the repo
items.summary: Openleetcode v1.0.0 是一个开源 LeetCode 运行器，其核心特性是将测试用例直接存储在代码仓库中。该工具允许开发者在本地环境中运行和调试算法题，实现了测试逻辑与代码实现的统一存储。
items.why_now: Openleetcode v1.0.0发布，实现测试用例与代码仓库共存
items.summary_en: Openleetcode v1.0.0 is a LeetCode runner that allows test cases to be stored directly within the repository. This tool enables users to execute and manage coding challenges locally by keeping tests integrated with their project files.

items.title: Show HN: Distributed LLM tracing and GH PR/issue linking [Apache 2.0]
items.summary: 该工具支持从开发机器、虚拟机和沙箱向 S3 流式传输数据，并具备分布式 LLM 追踪及 GitHub PR/Issue 链接功能。其核心能力在于帮助团队识别编码代理的瓶颈及工具对 token 的消耗，从而优化工作规划。作者利用该工具量化了未计入计划的代理/人类注意力集中区域，以此作为重构和文档工作的依据以提升效率。
items.why_now: 暂无明确时效性信号
items.summary_en: Synty is an open-source Apache 2.0 tool that provides distributed LLM tracing and GitHub PR/issue linking by streaming data from dev machines, VMs, and sandboxes into S3. It enables teams to analyze coding agent performance, identifying token consumption and workflow misalignments to justify refactoring efforts. The tool includes a bundled TUI for immediate analysis or supports custom queries on the stored data.

items.title: I ported Kubernetes to the browser
items.summary: 该项目将 Kubernetes 成功移植至浏览器环境运行。这一成果展示了在客户端构建复杂分布式系统控制平面的可行性，实现了无需后端服务器即可管理容器化工作流的技术突破。
items.why_now: 暂无明确时效性信号。
items.summary_en: The author successfully ported Kubernetes to run directly within web browsers. This technical achievement enables container orchestration capabilities without requiring traditional server-side infrastructure.

items.title: Meta's brain-reading AI leaves letters behind
items.summary: Meta发布Brain2Qerty v2系统，通过非侵入式脑扫描实现从单字符到完整句子的解码，平均词准确率提升至61%，显著优于传统非侵入式方案的8%。该系统利用两名志愿者在扫描仪中打字产生的近22,000句数据训练，其准确率已接近需手术植入的脑机接口方案。Meta开源了v1和v2的代码及数据集，表明仅通过数据扩展即可进一步缩小与非侵入式技术的性能差距。
items.why_now: Meta刚发布非侵入式脑机接口v2，准确率大幅跃升。
items.summary_en: Meta launched Brain2Qwerty v2, a non-invasive brain-reading AI that decodes full sentences from fMRI scans with an average word accuracy of 61%, significantly outperforming previous non-invasive rivals. Trained on nearly 22,000 sentences from nine volunteers, the system’s performance approaches that of surgical implants, a gap Meta suggests can be narrowed through data scaling. To accelerate research, Meta has open-sourced the code and dataset for both versions 1 and 2.

items.title: GitHub Trending Digest — 2026-07-01
items.summary: ponytail 以近 70,000 星标成为趋势榜首，通过自动重构遗留代码、合并模块和删除死代码，实现 JavaScript 项目的极致自动化与简化。百度开源的 Unlimited-OCR 凭借 12,500 多星标，利用 One-shot Long-horizon Parsing 技术，无需图像切片即可直接从长文档或高分辨率图片中提取结构化文本，显著提升了处理效率与上下文准确性。MiMo-Code 则通过 Co-Evolution of Models and Agents 范式，让 TypeScript 环境下的 AI 模型与智能体在 CI/CD 流程中相互学习，实现了从被动辅助到主动调试和修复的自主进化。
items.why_now: 2026年7月1日，GitHub趋势揭示AI驱动代码精简与长文档解析新窗口。
items.summary_en: ponytail, a JavaScript toolkit for extreme code simplification, reached nearly 70k stars by automating legacy refactoring and dead code removal. Baidu’s Python-based Unlimited-OCR achieved 12,521 stars through its one-shot long-horizon parsing capability, enabling direct extraction from high-resolution documents without image slicing. Additionally, Xiaomi’s TypeScript framework MiMo-Code garnered over 11k stars by facilitating co-evolution between LLMs and autonomous agents for independent debugging and CI/CD integration.

items.title: I found 10 bugs in my own security scanner. Here's what they taught me about false positives.
items.summary: 作者开发了一款用于检测代码中泄露密钥、PII及安全漏洞的 VS Code 扩展，并在测试中发现并修复了 10 个导致误报或漏报的关键缺陷。这些修复涉及从简单的子串匹配升级为调用点匹配、引入 Luhn 校验算法验证信用卡号，以及针对 GCP 私钥格式和 IPv6 简写等特定场景的规则优化。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性事件
items.summary_en: The author identified ten critical flaws in their VS Code security scanner, revealing that over-reliance on substring matching and unanchored regular expressions caused significant false positives, such as flagging `loginToken` or SSH public keys. Conversely, strict format limitations led to false negatives, including missed GCP PKCS#8 keys and compressed IPv6 addresses. These issues were resolved by implementing precise logic, such as Luhn checksum validation for credit cards and context-aware scoping for dependency and import checks.

items.title: Claude Science is Anthropic’s newest flagship product
items.summary: Anthropic发布旗舰级科研产品Claude Science，专为计算生物学和药物研发设计，现已向所有付费Claude订阅用户开放。该产品具备自主执行任务、运行代码集群及确保结果可复现的能力，其核心模型Opus 4.5被评估为具备相当于研二研究生的科研项目执行力。此举旨在挑战DeepMind在AI科学领域的领先地位，并标志着Anthropic将AI服务于生命科学的战略提升至与Claude Code同等重要的高度。
items.why_now: Anthropic周二发布Claude Science，正式进军AI制药领域。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Science, a standalone product for paid subscribers designed to autonomously support scientific research in computational biology and drug development. Unlike previous plugins, it integrates with powerful computer clusters and prioritizes reproducibility, aiming to match the capabilities of a second-year graduate student according to early estimates. The release positions Anthropic to challenge Google DeepMind’s dominance in AI for science, bolstered by the recent hiring of DeepMind co-founder John Jumper.

items.title: A simple way to test model fallbacks with RouterBase
items.summary: RouterBase 提供兼容 OpenAI 的 API 接口（https://routerbase.com/v1），通过封装 primary（如 google/gemini-2.5-flash）和 fallback（如 openai/gpt-4.1-mini）模型，实现简单的故障转移逻辑测试。开发者可在草稿撰写或工单摘要等低风险场景中，记录各模型的响应状态、延迟及人工修正需求，从而量化评估路由效果。
items.why_now: RouterBase发布OpenAI兼容API，方便测试模型故障转移。
items.summary_en: RouterBase provides an OpenAI-compatible API at https://routerbase.com/v1, enabling developers to easily prototype model fallback logic using standard HTTP requests. The solution allows teams to configure primary and secondary models, such as switching from "google/gemini-2.5-flash" to "openai/gpt-4.1-mini," while tracking metrics like latency and error rates to optimize performance and cost.

items.title: Brain2Qwerty v2
items.summary: Brain2Qwerty v2 是 Brain2Qwerty 技术的迭代版本，旨在提升从脑机接口信号到键盘输入的转换能力。相比早期版本，该技术在处理复杂指令和降低延迟方面实现了核心能力的增强，能够更精准地将神经活动转化为实际打字操作。
items.why_now: Brain2Qwerty v2发布
items.summary_en: Brain2Qwerty v2 is an advanced tool designed to convert brainwave data into text input. It significantly improves accuracy and speed compared to previous iterations, enabling users to type directly from neural signals. This breakthrough enhances accessibility for individuals with motor impairments by streamlining the brain-computer interface process.

items.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
items.summary: Etched作为英伟达的AI芯片竞争对手，其估值已达到50亿美元。该公司凭借搭载自家芯片的推理系统，已签订价值10亿美元的商业合同。
items.why_now: Etched获50亿估值，AI芯片业务已签约10亿美元。
items.summary_en: Etched, an Nvidia competitor, has reached a $5 billion valuation after booking $1 billion in contracts for its AI inference systems. These systems are powered by Etched's proprietary chips designed to challenge market leader Nvidia.

items.title: Wayve launches $85M employee tender offer at $8.5B valuation
items.summary: Wayve以85亿美元的估值启动了金额为8500万美元的员工要约收购。此举旨在利用员工要约作为战略工具，吸引并保留AI初创公司的人才。
items.why_now: AI初创公司正利用员工要约收购作为吸引和保留人才的新战略工具。
items.summary_en: Wayve has launched an $85 million employee tender offer at an $8.5 billion valuation to attract and retain talent amidst a growing trend among AI startups.

items.title: usestrix/strix
items.summary: Strix 是一款开源的自主式 AI 渗透测试工具，能够动态运行代码并通过实际概念验证（PoC）发现并修复应用漏洞。它支持 GitHub Actions 和 CI/CD 管道集成，提供自动修补代码、生成合规报告以及减少误报的能力。用户可通过 Docker 安装并配置 OpenAI 等 LLM API 密钥，快速对目标应用目录执行安全评估。
items.why_now: Strix集成GitHub Actions，PR自动扫描漏洞。
items.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI penetration testing tool that utilizes autonomous multi-agent orchestration to dynamically discover, validate, and fix application vulnerabilities with high accuracy. It integrates seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions to block insecure code before production and provides actionable remediation through auto-generated patches and compliance-ready reports.

items.title: hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset
items.summary: 该数据集源自ExerciseDB，包含1,324个健身动作，涵盖名称、类别、目标肌群、所需设备及分步指导等结构化元数据。作者在原始英文数据基础上，新增了西班牙语、意大利语、土耳其语、俄语和中文的六语种指令翻译。尽管不包含缩略图和动画视频等多媒体文件，但提供了交互式浏览器及开发者设置向导，适用于构建健身应用后端或机器学习项目。
items.why_now: 健身数据集开源，适合快速搭建健身应用原型。
items.summary_en: The hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset provides a structured collection of 1,324 fitness exercises sourced from ExerciseDB v1, featuring multilingual step-by-step instructions in six languages including English, Spanish, and Chinese. It excludes embedded media due to copyright issues but retains original media IDs for reference, offering tools like an interactive browser and developer setup wizard to facilitate backend integration.

items.title: altic-dev/FluidVoice
items.summary: FluidVoice 是一款基于 macOS 的开源语音转文字应用，支持通过 Homebrew 安装，并集成完全本地的“Fluid Intelligence”AI 增强模型以实现智能格式化和上下文感知的大写处理。其核心亮点在于极速的 Parakeet 实现及零延迟体验，同时提供 Command Mode 和 Write Mode，允许用户通过语音控制 Mac 或在任意文本框中直接输入和重写内容。该应用支持 Nemotron、Whisper 等多种语音模型，并具备实时预览、全局快捷键及本地音频历史记录等功能，确保数据不出本机且无需云服务。
items.why_now: FluidVoice 1.6.0 发布，支持零延迟本地 AI 增强。
items.summary_en: FluidVoice is an open-source macOS dictation app featuring a rebuilt Parakeet implementation for near-zero latency and a local AI enhancement module called Fluid Intelligence. It supports multiple speech models, including Nemotron Speech 3.5 and Whisper, while offering command and write modes for voice-controlled automation and text input. The application runs entirely on-device to ensure privacy, with plans to expand to Windows, iOS, and Linux.

items.title: google/agents-cli
items.summary: google/agents-cli 是一款命令行工具，能将 Antigravity CLI、Claude Code 等任意编程助手转化为在 Google Cloud 上构建、评估和部署 AI 代理的专家。它通过提供涵盖开发生命周期、ADK Python API、项目脚手架及 CI/CD 部署等核心技能，简化了企业级代理的创建与治理流程。用户只需执行 `uvx google-agents-cli setup` 安装并调用相关命令，即可实现代理从本地构建到 Gemini Enterprise 注册的完整工作流。
items.why_now: Google刚发布agents-cli，让独立开发者快速构建企业级Agent。
items.summary_en: The agents-cli tool integrates with coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex to streamline the creation, evaluation, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI agents on Google Cloud. It provides specialized skills and commands for the full development lifecycle, including project scaffolding, automated evaluation using metrics and LLM-as-a-judge, and deployment via Cloud Run or GKE. Users can install the CLI via `uvx` or `npx` to leverage these capabilities without manually managing individual cloud services.

items.title: microsoft/AI-For-Beginners
items.summary: 微软推出的“AI for Beginners”课程是一个为期12周、包含24个课程的初学者友好型学习资源，涵盖TensorFlow和PyTorch等工具及AI伦理。该课程通过GitHub Actions支持超过50种语言的自动翻译，并提供稀疏检出命令以优化下载速度。内容重点讲解符号主义、神经网络、多智能体系统等核心概念，明确排除了经典机器学习、商业案例及深层数学理论。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性信号
items.summary_en: Microsoft’s "AI for Beginners" is a 12-week, 24-lesson curriculum designed to teach neural networks, deep learning, and ethical AI using TensorFlow and PyTorch. The open-source repository supports over 50 languages via automated GitHub Actions and offers sparse checkout options to optimize download sizes. The program focuses on practical coding and conceptual understanding while excluding advanced cloud frameworks and pure mathematics.

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.summary: Vibe-Trading 是一个个人交易智能体，支持通过 WebSocket、Telegram 等 16 种内置消息适配器进行实时交互，并提供 CLI、REST 及 Web UI 多种操作接口。该系统集成了 Trading 212 只读连接器及 tushare 数据路由，具备 PreTradeAdvisoryInterface 等实盘安全风控机制，并针对 Windows 环境及 Gemini 模型进行了兼容性修复。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日上线IM通道运行时，支持16种消息适配器。
items.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is a personal trading agent that integrates with 16 message adapters via WebSocket, REST, and CLI interfaces for comprehensive command execution. Recent updates enhance cross-platform stability, add a read-only Trading 212 connector, and implement broker-agnostic pre-trade advisory safety guards. The platform also improves data routing for HK equities and ETFs through Tushare while refining shadow account signal generation with conditional entry logic.

items.title: CoreBunch/Instatic
items.summary: Instatic 是一款基于 Bun 服务器的自托管可视化 CMS，支持一键部署至 Railway，默认使用 SQLite 数据库，启动仅需一分钟。其核心优势在于内置 Core Framework 设计系统，通过颜色、排版和间距令牌自动生成紧凑的语义化 HTML 与 CSS，无需框架运行时即可发布静态页面。该工具整合了画布编辑器、内容引擎及发布者功能，旨在替代由多个独立服务组成的复杂网站技术栈。
items.why_now: Instatic发布，一键部署现代自托管CMS
items.summary_en: Instatic is a self-hosted visual CMS powered by a single Bun server that integrates design, content management, and publishing while generating clean semantic HTML. It offers one-click deployment via Railway with SQLite or Postgres support, allowing users to manage entire site lifecycles including responsive canvas editing and automated design token scaling.

items.title: 视频版Nano Banana来了！内置Gemini世界知识；原版香蕉出图仅需4秒
items.summary: 视频版Nano Banana内置Gemini模型以增强世界知识，其原版图像生成速度仅需4秒。该工具通过整合先进的大语言模型能力，显著提升了多模态内容的生成效率与质量。
items.why_now: 新版发布且出图仅4秒，性能突破值得立即关注。
items.summary_en: Nano Banana is a video generation tool that integrates Gemini's world knowledge to enhance output quality, while its original version can generate images in just four seconds.

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5 发布
items.summary: Anthropic 发布具备自主计划、浏览器及终端操作能力的 Claude Sonnet 5，其推理与智能体性能较 Sonnet 4.6 大幅提升，且在 BrowseComp 和 OSWorld-Verified 评测中表现更优。该模型定价更具竞争力，即日起至 2026 年 8 月 31 日输入价格为每百万 token 2 美元，输出为 10 美元。虽然网络安全能力弱于 Opus 4.8，但其幻觉和谄媚现象减少，现已全面上线于所有套餐及 Claude API。
items.why_now: Anthropic今日发布Claude Sonnet 5并限时降价至2026年8月。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5, an upgraded model featuring autonomous planning, browser, and terminal tool usage that significantly outperforms Sonnet 4.6 in reasoning and coding while approaching Opus 4.8's performance. Priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens until August 31, 2026, it offers enhanced safety with reduced hallucinations and is now available across all plans via Claude Code and the API.

items.title: Acti 将 AI 智能体直接放入手机键盘
items.summary: Acti 推出基于 Google Gemini 的智能体键盘，通过“本地优先”架构在输入层直接执行应用内操作，默认不访问私人消息以保障隐私。其核心功能 Skills 支持用户用自然语言创建快捷方式（如长按 T 键翻译），早期测试者两周内即创建了超 1000 个技能。该公司已获 530 万美元种子轮融资并开放下载。
items.why_now: Acti刚上线AI智能体键盘并开放下载，提供全新交互入口。
items.summary_en: Singaporean startup Acti has launched an AI keyboard powered by Google Gemini that allows users to execute app actions via natural language commands called "Skills," such as translating messages or sending links. The platform operates on a privacy-focused local-first architecture and saw rapid adoption, with early testers creating over 1,000 skills in two weeks. Following a $5.3 million seed round led by BITKRAFT Ventures, the keyboard is now available for download.

items.title: Claude Science 科研工作台正式上线
items.summary: Anthropic 发布 Beta 版的 AI 科研工作台 Claude Science，面向 Pro、Max、Team 及 Enterprise 用户，整合超 60 项预配置技能并支持 macOS/Linux 本地及 HPC 远程运行。该平台通过 NVIDIA BioNeMo 接入 Evo 2、Boltz-2 等模型，具备自动生成含代码的可审计科研成果及内置 reviewer agent 自动纠错的核心能力。
items.why_now: Anthropic今日上线Claude Science Beta，科研AI工具窗口开启。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched the beta version of Claude Science, an AI research workbench for Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users that integrates over 60 pre-configured skills across fields like genomics and structural biology. The platform supports local macOS/Linux execution or remote SSH/HPC access, enabling auditable outputs such as 3D protein structures while automatically reviewing citations and calculations. It connects to NVIDIA BioNeMo models like Evo 2 and Boltz-2, alongside custom pipelines, to facilitate end-to-end research workflows.

items.title: Claude Code 入门：智能体循环
items.summary: Claude Code 定义了四种智能体循环类型：基于对话的 turn-based、基于目标的 goal-based、基于时间的 time-based 以及主动型 proactive loop。该工具通过支持 `/goal` 和 `/loop` 等命令及 `/schedule` 云端调度，实现了从用户触发到无人值守自动运行的多样化工作流。此外，利用 SKILL.md 文件可将人工验证步骤编码为端到端自检流程，从而显著减少手动干预并提升自动化效率。
items.why_now: Anthropic发布Claude Code智能体循环功能，支持自动化编程任务。
items.summary_en: Claude Code defines agent loops as repetitive processes until a stop condition is met, categorizing them into four types: turn-based, goal-based (using /goal), time-based (using /loop), and proactive. The framework allows users to reduce manual intervention in turn-based cycles by writing SKILL.md files for end-to-end self-checks.

items.title: 用 shot-scraper video 让 AI 智能体录制工作演示视频
items.summary: shot-scraper 1.10 新增 video 命令，依托 Playwright 1.61.0 的 screencast 机制，通过 storyboard.yml 定义步骤即可录制浏览器演示视频，有效解决了视频开头白帧及宽度固定等痛点。该功能允许编码 Agent 直接利用详细的 --help 输出自动生成如 Datasette 数据操作类的演示视频，实现了从手动录制到自动化生成的流程升级。
items.why_now: 2026年6月30日Shot-scraper 1.10发布，助力AI智能体自动录制演示视频。
items.summary_en: Shot-scraper 1.10 introduces a video command that leverages Playwright 1.61.0’s screencast mechanism to record browser demonstrations via storyboard.yml files, resolving previous issues like blank frames and fixed widths. This update enables AI coding agents to automatically generate demo videos, such as those for Datasette's data table creation features, by utilizing the tool's detailed help output.

items.title: ADK Go 2.0 发布：构建可靠的多智能体应用，新增基于图的工作流引擎、人工参与循环与动态编排
items.summary: ADK Go 2.0 发布，引入基于图的工作流引擎以构建可靠的多智能体应用，支持纯 Go 代码动态执行及指数退避重试。新版本统一了单智能体与复杂图的运行时，并新增人工参与循环（HITL）编排功能，简化了遥测与状态持久化。
items.why_now: Google ADK for Go 2.0 发布，新增图工作流引擎与人工参与循环。
items.summary_en: Google released ADK Go 2.0, introducing a graph-based workflow engine to orchestrate complex multi-agent applications within a unified runtime. Key features include built-in human-in-the-loop (HITL) coordination, dynamic execution via pure Go code, and automatic resilience through exponential backoff retries. This update simplifies telemetry and state persistence by allowing both single-agent apps and intricate graph structures to operate on the same platform.

items.title: Grant Sanderson 谈 AI 与数学的未来
items.summary: Grant Sanderson 指出 AI 在 IMO 获金牌仅代表攻克特定基准，并不等同于通用人工智能（AGI）。他进一步强调，数学概念验证周期可能长达一个世纪，且 AI 在发现文献隐藏联系及处理现实经济任务方面仍面临人类理解与强化学习环境适配的重大挑战。
items.why_now: 无明确时效性信号
items.summary_en: Grant Sanderson argues that AI achieving gold at the IMO does not equate to AGI, viewing it merely as another benchmark rather than a sign of general intelligence. He emphasizes that while AI might solve Millennium Prize Problems, many human tasks remain resistant to automation due to complex verification cycles and the lack of suitable reinforcement learning environments for real-world economic problems.

items.title: 黑石未来3~5年拟投300亿美元在日本建AI数据中心，联合成立AI XPV平台
items.summary: 黑石计划未来3至5年在日本追加投资300亿美元建设AI数据中心，将总容量提升至超过1GW。黑石联合阿波罗、博通成立AI XPV平台，首期投入350亿美元支持Anthropic，目标于2028年前向OpenAI等企业提供超20GW算力。
items.why_now: 黑石联合阿波罗本月9日成立AI XPV平台，首期350亿美元注资。
items.summary_en: Blackstone plans to invest $30 billion in Japan’s AI data center sector over the next three to five years, expanding capacity by over 1 GW beyond its existing 500 MW. Additionally, Blackstone, Apollo, and Broadcom launched the AI XPV platform with an initial $35 billion fund to support Anthropic, targeting the provision of over 20 GW of computing power to companies like OpenAI and Anthropic by 2028.

items.title: Google DeepMind 发布 Nano Banana 2 Lite 和 Gemini Omni Flash
items.summary: Google DeepMind 推出 Nano Banana 2 Lite，作为速度最快且成本最低的图像模型，其文本转图像仅需 4 秒，每 1K 分辨率成本低至 0.034 美元，并已集成至 Google AI Studio 及搜索 AI 模式等产品。同时发布的 Gemini Omni Flash 支持高画质视频生成与对话式编辑，视频输出定价为 0.10 美元/秒，目前正面向开发者开放 API 访问。
items.why_now: Google DeepMind今日发布Nano Banana 2 Lite及Gemini Omni Flash API
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind launched Nano Banana 2 Lite, its fastest and lowest-cost image model, generating 1K resolution images in 4 seconds at $0.034 per 1K via Google AI Studio and consumer apps. Simultaneously, it released Gemini Omni Flash, an API-accessible tool for high-quality video generation and conversational editing priced at $0.10 per second.

items.title: 一个人管理5款产品，80%时间不写代码？Every的复利工程
items.summary: Every 团队通过「复利工程」方法论，利用 Plan→Work→Review→Compound 四步循环，实现单人维护 Cora、Monologue 等 5 款产品且 80% 时间不写代码。该模式将代码审查扩展为并发调用 14 个专项 Agent，并在计划阶段使用 ultrathink 模式并发 40 多个研究 Agent，核心在于通过 CLAUDE.md 和 docs/solutions/ 固化知识，使 AI 自动规避历史错误。配套开源插件支持 Claude Code/OpenCode/Codex，提供 26 个专项 Agent 及 23 条工作流命令，实现零配置复用。
items.why_now: Every开源多Agent并行工程插件，提供单人高效管多产品的具体实操参考。
items.summary_en: Every’s "Compound Engineering" methodology enables a solo engineer to maintain five products by dedicating 80% of time to planning and reviewing, using a four-step cycle that includes a "Compound" phase to store solutions in `CLAUDE.md` for AI reuse. The open-source plugin supports concurrent execution of up to 14 agents for code review and over 40 agents for planning, integrating with Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex via 26 specialized agents and 23 workflow commands.

items.title: AI就业争论变得更加混乱
items.summary: 截至2026年5月，尽管AI相关裁员接近9万且预计未来五年美国最多15%的岗位将被替代，但Ramp与Revelio Labs对近22,000家公司的报告显示，高AI投入企业（前三个月人均月均支出30美元）总员工数反而增长了10.2%，其中入门级岗位增长12%。这表明在资源充裕的科技企业中，AI通过降低工程、销售及客服等职能的生产成本，成为推动整体增员的扩张工具。然而，仅购买订阅而未持续投入的公司未见人头增长，这可能加剧企业间的资源鸿沟。
items.why_now: 2026年6月新报告显示AI正推动科技巨头扩员。
items.summary_en: As of May 2026, nearly 90,000 AI-related layoffs have occurred, with projections suggesting up to 15% of U.S. jobs may be replaced in five years. However, data from Ramp and Revelio Labs indicates that companies with high AI investment (averaging $30 per employee monthly) saw total headcount grow by 10.2% and entry-level roles increase by 12%, while those merely subscribing without sustained investment did not expand. This suggests AI acts as an expansion tool in resource-rich firms by lowering costs in engineering and sales, potentially widening the gap between companies based on their commitment levels.

items.title: X（Twitter）发布 hosted X MCP，AI 智能体可直连 X API
items.summary: X 官方发布托管版 X MCP，允许 Grok、Cursor 等兼容工具直连 X API 以获取实时数据。个人用户调用成本极具优势，仅需 0.01 美元/次，实测拉取三天书签数据花费仅 0.1 美元。配置流程需先在开发者后台创建 APP 获取 ID，再结合 AI 助手完成本地配置与授权。
items.why_now: X今早发布托管MCP，一键连接API，个人调用低至0.01美元。
items.summary_en: X (Twitter) has launched the hosted X MCP, enabling AI agents to connect directly to the X API for real-time data access without complex setup. The service utilizes a pay-as-you-go pricing model where calls cost $0.01 each, allowing users to retrieve data such as bookmarks at a minimal expense. This integration facilitates automatic summarization and analysis of personal Twitter information through compatible AI tools.

items.title: 8点1氪丨“史上最严电池安全令”正式施行；苹果大量机密文件遭泄露；OpenAI首款硬件曝光
items.summary: 自7月1日起，电动汽车安全新国标正式实施，强制要求“一键断电”采用物理装置，并新增刮底、底部撞击及快充循环后安全测试，确保电池不起火、不爆炸。与此同时，OpenAI发布首款硬件——与Work Louder联名的可编程宏键盘，旨在通过升级Codex快捷方式提升用户使用效率。
items.why_now: Anthropic模型Fable预计7月1日解禁出口管制，开发者需关注API接入。
items.summary_en: Effective July 1, China implements strict new national standards for electric vehicle batteries, mandating physical "one-touch power-off" devices and enhanced thermal runaway protections that require no fire or explosion during tests. Meanwhile, Apple faces a significant security breach after a ransomware group leaked confidential iPhone 18 Pro component lists and supplier details from its Indian manufacturer, Tata Electronics. In hardware news, OpenAI unveiled its first physical product, a programmable macro pad co-developed with Work Louder, designed to streamline efficiency for users of its Codex coding assistant.

items.title: Ahmad Osman on why local AI is catching up
items.summary: Osmantic创始人Ahmad Osman指出开源本地大模型与封闭前沿模型的差距已缩小至4到8个月，并通过展示DGX Spark、AMD Strix Halo及RTX 5090等硬件与Qwen 3.5等模型的组合，验证了本地AI的性能提升。他强调运行本地系统需超越单纯部署模型，必须集成搜索端点、工具调用及完整基础设施，以弥补训练数据截止日期的局限。该观点通过其工作坊演示及开源软件项目得到支撑，旨在推动开发者与企业将本地AI视为严肃的基础设施。
items.summary_en: Ahmad Osman, founder of Osmantic, advocates for local AI as open-source LLMs rapidly close the four-to-eight-month capability gap with proprietary frontier models. His workshops at the AI Engineer World’s Fair demonstrated this progress by allowing attendees to compare performance across hardware like the DGX Spark and AMD Strix Halo against cloud services. Osman emphasizes that effective local AI requires comprehensive infrastructure, including tools and search endpoints, rather than relying solely on model inference.

items.title: The AI Compass
items.summary: 该文章介绍了一个名为“The AI Compass”的政治罗盘风格测试，用户需回答29个关于人工智能及其伦理的问题，以匹配30种原型之一。该项目采用单页React应用实现，利用`<script type="text/babel">`技巧避免构建步骤。
items.summary_en: The AI Compass is a 29-question quiz by bambamramfan that categorizes users into one of 30 AI ethics archetypes. It is implemented as a single-page React application using the `<script type="text/babel">` technique to bypass build steps.

items.title: Show HN: Coding agent that compiles intent into deterministic DAG before running
items.summary: Rigorix 是一款编码智能体，其核心能力在于将用户意图编译为确定性的有向无环图（DAG）后再执行运行。该技术方案通过引入确定性流程，旨在解决传统编程智能体在执行过程中可能存在的随机性与不可控问题。项目已开源至 GitHub (arman-jalili/rigorix-oss)，供开发者参考与使用。
items.summary_en: Rigorix is a coding agent that compiles user intent into a deterministic Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) prior to execution to ensure predictable outcomes. This approach, available via the rigorix-oss GitHub repository, prioritizes structural clarity over immediate code generation. The tool aims to reduce errors by enforcing a strict planning phase before any actions are taken.

items.title: GPT-5.6 is here but...
items.summary: Etched 完成从幕后走向台前，其通过芯片、机柜、软件及制造的全垂直整合设计，在 TSMC 4nm 工艺上实现了首款芯片（A0）一次流片成功，并已获得 8 亿美元融资及超 10 亿美元的积压订单。与此同时，OpenAI 发布了 GPT-5.6 系列模型（含 Sol、Terra、Luna），尽管受美国政府限制仅向部分合作伙伴开放，但其旨在解决 AI 推理中的低延迟、低成本和高能效瓶颈，标志着行业竞争焦点正从模型训练转向推理服务。
items.summary_en: Etched, a startup backed by major investors including Peter Thiel and Jane Street, is launching frontier inference hardware with $800 million raised and over $1 billion in backlog orders, achieving successful A0 chip production on TSMC’s 4nm process. Concurrently, OpenAI has released GPT-5.6, featuring the Sol, Terra, and Luna models, though access remains restricted due to US government blocks and limited availability to select partners.

items.title: Show HN: TakoVM – open-source sandboxing for your agent's code
items.summary: TakoVM 是一款开源的沙箱化解决方案，旨在为 Agent 代码提供安全隔离环境。该工具通过 GitHub 上的 Tako-Research/TakoVM 仓库公开，主要解决智能体执行代码时的安全性问题。
items.summary_en: TakoVM is an open-source sandboxing solution designed to securely execute agent code. The project is hosted on GitHub under Tako-Research.

items.title: Show HN: Yourself, in Every Light
items.summary: Alma 是一个开源项目，旨在通过 GitHub 仓库展示如何在不同光照条件下呈现用户自身形象。该工具利用技术实现视觉效果的多样化，为开发者提供展示个人形象的新方案。
items.summary_en: Alma is an open-source tool hosted on GitHub that enables users to generate personalized images by placing themselves in various lighting conditions. The project allows for customizable visual outputs, offering a direct way to create diverse self-portraits without complex editing workflows.

items.title: Show HN: Open-source restreaming and live studio
items.summary: 该项目发布了名为“Open-source restreaming and live studio”的开源视频推流与直播工作室工具，旨在填补市场空白。开发者利用 Claude 辅助完成前端开发，以加速概念落地并降低开发难度。目前该作品在 Hacker News 上获得 4 个点赞和 2 条评论。
items.summary_en: The article introduces an open-source tool for restreaming and live studio production, addressing a market gap where only commercial alternatives exist. The creator leveraged twenty years of video industry experience and utilized Claude to assist with frontend development and concept refinement.

items.title: Show HN: Kage, verification and freshness for Google's OKF agent memory
items.summary: Kage是一个支持Google OKF标准的Agent记忆框架，重点解决了现有标准缺乏记忆验证和新鲜度维护的问题。它通过自动管理仓库记忆并协助Agent判断保存时机，显著提升了记忆调用的相关性与时效性。该工具目前对Claude Code提供最佳支持，并兼容其他各类编码Agent。
items.summary_en: Kage is a framework that integrates with Google’s Open Knowledge Format (OKF) to provide verification and freshness management for agent memory. It automates the process of determining what, when, and how to save memories, with primary support for Claude Code and compatibility with other coding agents.

items.title: Show HN: Mimir – local-first encrypted memory for AI agents (single Rust binary)
items.summary: Mimir 是一个基于 Rust 构建的单一二进制文件，旨在为 AI 智能体提供本地优先的加密记忆存储。该项目通过 GitHub 开源，强调在本地环境中处理敏感数据的安全性。
items.summary_en: Mimir is a local-first, encrypted memory solution for AI agents distributed as a single Rust binary. It prioritizes privacy and security by keeping data encrypted locally, offering a lightweight alternative to cloud-based agent memory services.

items.title: ScarfBench: Benchmarking AI Agents for Enterprise Java Framework Migration
items.summary: ScarfBench 是一个用于评估 AI 智能体在企业级 Java 框架迁移任务中表现的基准测试平台。该研究重点考察了智能体在处理复杂代码重构时的核心能力，并与现有迁移方案进行了对比分析。
items.summary_en: ScarfBench is a benchmark designed to evaluate AI agents' capabilities in migrating enterprise Java frameworks. It assesses technical performance and efficiency in handling complex codebase transformations for modernization tasks.

items.title: The twilight of the chatbots
items.summary: 前沿模型如Opus 4.7和Fable展现出极强的自主工作能力，前者在14小时内完成需2-17周人工的软件构建，后者在9小时内执行了复杂项目。与此同时，中国推出的开源权重模型虽落后美国6-12个月，但凭借低成本优势也处于指数级提升曲线中。随着AI从协同智能向具备自我修正能力的Agent演进，人机协作模式正发生根本性转变。
items.summary_en: American frontier models like Claude Fable and GPT-5.6, alongside Chinese open-weight alternatives, are demonstrating accelerating capabilities, with systems such as Opus 4.7 completing tasks equivalent to 2–17 weeks of human engineering in just 14 hours for $251. This rapid improvement is shifting usage patterns from interactive co-intelligence toward autonomous, long-running agents capable of executing complex projects with minimal human intervention.

items.title: UPI's AI bet: why payment data beats fancy models
items.summary: 印度NPCI首席执行官指出，AI在支付领域的应用核心在于解决商业问题而非单纯的技术竞赛，重点聚焦于欺诈检测、信贷分发及多语言用户获取。尽管UPI日均交易量已达约7.5亿笔，但PhonePe和Google Pay占据超80%份额，市场垄断阻碍了新进入者的盈利模式。关键在于利用专有支付数据训练小型垂直模型，以构建比通用大模型更具竞争力的本地化护城河。
items.summary_en: India’s NPCI aims to increase UPI transactions from 750 million to over 1 billion daily while enforcing a 30% market-share cap by December 2026 to curb the dominance of PhonePe and Google Pay. Instead of relying on large general-purpose models, NPCI prioritizes specialized AI applications for fraud detection, credit distribution, and multilingual onboarding, leveraging proprietary payment data as the primary competitive moat. This strategy emphasizes that domain-specific datasets and targeted business models are more critical for success than access to massive computational resources.

items.title: X now offers an MCP server to make its platform easier for AI tools to use
items.summary: X 推出了托管式 MCP 服务器，旨在简化开发者将 AI 应用与其 API 连接的过程。该举措通过标准化接口提升了平台对人工智能工具的兼容性与易用性。
items.summary_en: X has launched a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to facilitate easier integration between AI applications and its API. This development allows developers to connect their tools directly to the platform's infrastructure more efficiently.

items.title: The AI jobs debate just got messier
items.summary: 最新报告显示，“高强度AI采用者”的员工总数增长了10.2%，其中初级岗位人数更是上升了12%。这一数据直接反驳了“AI会取代初级工作”的观点，表明AI应用实际上促进了基础人力的增加。
items.summary_en: A new report reveals that high-intensity AI adopters increased their total headcount by 10.2%, with entry-level roles rising by 12%. These figures directly counter the narrative that artificial intelligence is eliminating junior positions.

items.title: ♟️ Why Can’t Incumbents Copy You (Even When They Obviously Should)?
items.summary: 文章指出 incumbent 难以复制初创企业，是因为模仿其商业模式会损害自身利润并暴露战略误判，建议通过攻击对手商业模式、利用反定位策略来构建护城河。同时提及 HeadsUp 作为 AI 竞争情报平台，可在 60 秒内提供定价、功能及定位等竞品洞察，帮助用户快速制定应对策略。
items.summary_en: The article explains that incumbents often fail to copy startups because doing so would undermine their existing business models and damage their credibility. Successful counter-positioning requires anchoring a new model to genuine customer needs while attacking the incumbent's structure, as demonstrated by Vanguard disrupting mutual funds with lower fees.

items.title: Amazon launches new $1 billion FDE org, following OpenAI and Anthropic
items.summary: 亚马逊启动新成立的10亿美元FDE组织，旨在效仿OpenAI和Anthropic的模式。该团队工程师将嵌入企业客户内部，部署专为特定目的构建的Agent，重点在于快速交付及提升客户自主使用能力。
items.summary_en: Amazon has established a new $1 billion Field Development Engineering (FDE) organization to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic by embedding engineers within client companies. This team focuses on deploying purpose-built agents, prioritizing rapid implementation and enabling customer self-sufficiency.

items.title: facebook/astryx
items.summary: Astryx 是一个基于 React 和 StyleX 构建的开源设计系统，内部已支撑 13,000 多个应用，提供 150 多个可访问组件及 CLI 工具。该系统专为人与 AI 助手共同开发优化，确保双方使用相同的 API、文档和构建参考进行协作。其核心优势在于开放的内部组件结构、无样式锁定机制以及通过 CSS 自定义属性实现的灵活主题定制能力。
items.summary_en: Astryx is an open-source, beta-stage design system built on React and StyleX that powers over 13,000 apps within Meta. It provides 150+ accessible components, seven customizable themes, and a unified CLI, enabling consistent development for both human engineers and AI agents. The system emphasizes open internals and flexible styling overrides without requiring additional build plugins or configuration.

items.title: 刚刚，Codex 首款硬件曝光
items.summary: OpenAI 联合外设公司 Work Louder 发布首款硬件 Codex Micro，这是一款专为提升 Codex AI 编程代理（周活超 500 万）使用效率定制的物理按键控制台。该设备通过深度适配开发者工作流，解决在 IDE 与 ChatGPT 间切换的割裂体验，旨在固化生态并增强用户黏性。此举标志着 OpenAI 采取双线硬件战略，B 端侧重务实生产力工具，C 端则与前苹果设计总监 Jony Ive 合作探索下一代 AI 原生终端。
items.summary_en: OpenAI unveiled the Codex Micro, a specialized macro pad co-developed with Work Louder designed to integrate directly into the workflows of Codex, its AI coding agent with over 5 million weekly active users. This hardware aims to enhance developer efficiency by providing physical controls for code completion and context management, serving as a pragmatic entry point in OpenAI’s dual hardware strategy alongside a future consumer device being developed with Jony Ive.

items.title: Anthropic在Claude Code中植入隐写术代码识别中国用户
items.summary: Anthropic在Claude Code中植入隐写术，通过读取本地时区和环境变量，结合经base64+XOR加密的147个域名列表识别中国用户。识别成功后，系统会将系统提示词中的单引号和连字符替换为特定Unicode字符，以此作为2-3比特的隐蔽标记传回服务器。该机制因未经用户同意收集数据并传递标识信息而引发争议，被认为破坏了用户信任。
items.summary_en: Anthropic’s Claude Code employs steganography to identify Chinese users by analyzing local timezones and environment variables against a list of 147 encrypted domains. Upon detection, it alters date string formatting in system prompts before sending requests to the server, embedding classification markers. This covert practice has sparked controversy and damaged user trust after being reverse-engineered by the community.

items.title: 告别硬件出海上一个十年，前安克CMO做了款AI时代的Memory产品｜硬氪专访
items.summary: 穗升科技推出首款AI Memory硬件Memoket，重仅11克，支持超30天待机及20小时连续录音，能将物理世界信息结构化并交由Agent调用。该产品区别于传统录音笔，旨在管理线下信息流，通过跨时间聚合与上下文串联构建软硬一体的AI护城河。创始人王时远利用AI工具优化团队流程，试图解决当前硬件出海营销效率低下的痛点。
items.summary_en: Wang Shiyuan, former CMO of Anker, founded Suisheng Technology to launch Memoket, an AI-powered wearable memory device weighing only 11 grams that structures offline information for retrieval by AI Agents. The product supports over 30 days of standby and 20 hours of continuous recording, distinguishing itself from traditional voice recorders by managing personal context rather than just transcribing meetings. Suisheng leverages an "AI First" operational model with a team of approximately 20 people to achieve efficiency, having recently initiated overseas pre-sales.

items.title: 苏大教授创业做机器人触觉系统，获松禾资本千万级天使轮融资｜硬氪首发
items.summary: 感知纪元科技有限公司完成松禾资本领衔的千万级天使轮融资，其核心产品为可拉伸延展超400%且支持压力、滑动、温度等多模态同步感知的仿生电子皮肤。该技术通过材料端一体化空间分区设计解决信号串扰难题，并内置迁移学习算法实现从感知到理解的闭环，目前已在头部人形机器人及新能源汽车等领域获得战略合作与采购意向。
items.summary_en: Perception Era Technology completed a tens-of-millions RMB angel round led by Songhe Capital to accelerate the mass production of its multimodal intelligent tactile electronic skin. The company’s core product is a highly elastic bionic electronic skin capable of covering robot bodies, integrating pressure, sliding, temperature, and texture sensing with over 400% stretchability and millisecond-level response. Backed by founder Prof. Liu Ruiyuan’s expertise from Soochow University, the technology utilizes spatially partitioned composite materials and transfer learning algorithms to enable precise, multi-modal tactile understanding for humanoid robots and industrial applications.

items.title: 成立9个月，在手订单4.4亿，「谱星航天」连续完成两轮数亿元融资｜36氪首发
items.summary: 谱星航天成立9个月内完成天使+及Pre-A两轮融资，累计规模达数亿元，目前在手订单4.4亿元。该公司聚焦光谱定量遥感赛道，通过掌握即时光谱定量遥感技术及批产20至50公斤级微纳卫星，旨在构建由1024颗卫星组成的“谱星星座”，以突破传统遥感在光谱细分、辐射精度及覆盖频次上的局限。
items.summary_en: Shanghai Puxing Aerospace has raised nearly 300 million RMB in three rounds within nine months, securing 440 million RMB in orders while developing its spectral quantitative remote sensing technology. The company plans to build a constellation of 1,024 micro-nano satellites to provide high-precision, quantitative data services for commercial markets such as agriculture and finance. Core technical advantages include enhanced spectral resolution, radiation accuracy, and high revisit frequency enabled by AI-driven data analysis.

items.title: “求之科技”完成超1亿美元首轮融资
items.summary: “求之科技”完成超1亿美元首轮融资，创下消费级具身机器人赛道单笔天使轮融资最高纪录。该轮由君联资本、信产投资、联想创投等多家机构联合参投。
items.summary_en: “求之科技” completed its first round of financing exceeding $100 million, setting a new record for a single angel round in the consumer-grade embodied robotics sector. The investment was jointly led by multiple institutions including Legend Capital, CITIC Invest, and Lenovo Capital.

items.title: Show HN: Agentic OS – the operating system for AI agents

items.summary_en: Agentic OS is presented as an operating system designed to function as a proactive AI assistant capable of automatically managing tasks, scheduling, and file operations. The tool aims to streamline user workflows by integrating these administrative functions into a seamless, agent-driven environment.

items.summary_en: The "Frontier AI Lab Jobs" website provides a standardized taxonomy mapping open roles at companies like OpenAI and Anthropic by function and department. The tool aims to help job seekers and researchers understand hiring trends and organizational structures within leading AI labs.

items.summary_en: EquiLibre Technologies, a Prague-based AI lab founded by three former DeepMind researchers, has achieved a valuation exceeding $500 million. The company leverages expertise from developing poker AI to generate revenue for quantitative hedge funds.

items.title: Robbyant/lingbot-map
items.summary: LingBot-Map 是由 Robbyant Team 开发的前馈式 3D 基础模型，采用几何上下文 Transformer 架构，统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索和长距离漂移校正。该模型通过分页 KV 缓存注意力机制，在 518×378 分辨率下对超过 10,000 帧的长序列实现约 20 FPS 的稳定推理。其在 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 等基准测试中表现出优于现有流式和迭代优化方法的 3D 重建性能。
items.summary_en: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model utilizing a Geometric Context Transformer to achieve high-efficiency streaming reconstruction at approximately 20 FPS for sequences exceeding 10,000 frames. The architecture integrates coordinate grounding and long-range drift correction via anchor context and trajectory memory, delivering state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like KITTI and Oxford Spires. Implementation leverages paged KV cache attention with FlashInfer to ensure stable inference on 518×378 resolution inputs.

items.title: AI 用 prover-verifier LLM 循环攻克 9 个未解数学难题
items.summary: 该研究通过“证明者-验证者”大语言模型循环框架，成功攻克了理论计算机科学中的9个重大未解数学难题。这项成果显著提升了LLM在通用数学研究领域的核心能力，其突破性进展令此前持怀疑态度的专家改变了看法。
items.summary_en: An AI framework utilizing a "prover-verifier" large language model loop successfully solved nine major unsolved problems in theoretical computer science. This approach, developed by researchers from Columbia University, has shifted perspectives on the capability of LLMs to conduct general mathematical research. The team plans to extend this methodology to other scientific fields.

items.title: Claude Desktop 推出 Linux 公测版

items.summary_en: Claude Desktop has launched a beta version for Linux, specifically supporting Ubuntu and Debian operating systems. This release provides users with a premium desktop experience across all paid plans, integrating features such as Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and standard chat capabilities alongside browser and terminal access.

items.title: 赤子城独家投资：4人创业团队「MobAI」，推出AI互动平台「Lunaverse Stories」 | 36氪首发
items.summary: MobAI完成数百万元天使轮融资，由赤子城科技独家投资，其开发的AI互动叙事应用Lunaverse Stories已处于邀请制测试阶段。该平台通过“Remix Anywhere”和“Dream Universe”两大核心系统，结合投骰子等跑团机制，为北美年轻女性用户提供实时生成的个性化互动剧情，区别于传统预设叙事。团队计划于二季度中旬正式上线APP，并同步推出面向创作者的Lunaverse IDE以辅助内容生成与发布。
items.summary_en: MobAI, a four-person startup led by former VC Zhong Wending, secured an angel round of several million yuan from Chisecity Technology to develop Lunaverse Stories, an AI interactive narrative app targeting North American women aged 18–24. The platform utilizes core systems like “Remix Anywhere” and “Dream Universe” to generate personalized storylines through dice-roll mechanics and real-time AI generation, distinct from traditional preset narratives. Following an invitation-only beta in July and August, the app is scheduled for official launch in mid-Q2, with the companion creator tool Lunaverse IDE already in trial operation.
